connector.name: ClicheFactory Document Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Extract structured JSON from PDFs, images, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, EML attachments, and DSPy pipelines.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package clichefactory-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the clichefactory account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CLICHEFACTORY_API_KEY

env.name: CLICHEFACTORY_API_URL
env.description: Optional ClicheFactory API base URL override.

env.name: LLM_MODEL_NAME
env.description: Model name for local mode, for example gemini/gemini-3-flash-preview.

env.name: LLM_API_KEY
env.description: LLM provider API key for local mode.
